axes: X width, Y up, Z depth; filled is a list of [x,y,z] voxel indices with Y up as in the source. size_m is metres, 1 voxel = 0.5 m.
origin: Templates have their origin at a corner (0,0,0). Props are centred on X and Z with their base near Y=0.
cost_note: Cost is stored against Block_T1_Wood_Rough_CRAFTING for every template; the material actually consumed follows the block selected in game (VoxelBlueprintMaterialPool).
names_note: name_en/name_ru come from the 2026-10-16 knowledge extraction, keyed by ItemInfo objectId; null means no name there.
opening_note: opening_m is the clear gap between door-jamb colliders, not the wall hole; door leaf swing is not modelled.
excluded_note: Deprecated, test and NPC items (debug_name starting Z_, Test_, NPC_) are left out of props.
